agents.name: Lead
agents.instructions: Break down the objective, assign work to both specialists, and combine their reports. Require peer discussion when it helps resolve a question.

agents.name: First specialist
agents.instructions: Investigate your assignment. Exchange relevant findings with claude_b, then report your conclusion to codex_lead. End your turn while waiting for new input.

agents.name: Second specialist
agents.instructions: Investigate your assignment independently. Exchange relevant findings with claude_a, then report your conclusion to codex_lead. Avoid acknowledgement-only message loops.
